metadata.Name: STAIR Captions
metadata.Description: A large-scale Japanese image caption dataset, called STAIR Captions. It contains over 820,000 crowdsourced Japanese captions for images from the MS-COCO dataset. The dataset was created to facilitate research in image captioning for languages other than English.
metadata.Paper Title: STAIR Captions: Constructing a Large-Scale Japanese Image Caption Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 55th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 2: Short Papers)
metadata.Abstract: Image captioning, which is the task of automatically generating a textual description of an image, has attracted a great deal of attention. Although a number of deep learning-based methods have been proposed for this task, most of them have been developed for English. One of the main reasons for this is the lack of a large-scale image caption dataset for other languages. In this paper, we construct a large-scale Japanese image caption dataset, which we call STAIR Captions. We crowdsourced Japanese captions for the 820,000 images in MS-COCO. We describe the details of our dataset construction and the results of our initial analysis of the dataset. We also build a Japanese image captioning model and show that our dataset is useful for this task. The dataset is publicly available at http://captions.stair.center/.
